a.lede: DuckDuckGo is courting schools frustrated by Google's AI restrictions, pointing educators to its search engine and options to disable AI features.
a.title: DuckDuckGo pitches itself to schools amid backlash over Google’s AI policy

b.lede: Google is tying up AI Overviews with traditional search, angering parents and educators who worry that easy, machine-generated answers are leaving kids less capable.
b.title: Google Is Forcing AI Overviews in Classrooms. Schools Are Searching for a Way Out
